_doc: Submodules whose gitlink advance is EXPECTED to be refused, with the reason.
A refusal is normally a real finding and must fail. But a STANDING refusal that
cannot be resolved from here turns advance-submodule-pointers permanently red,
and a workflow that has been red for weeks is one nobody reads — which is how a
genuinely NEW refusal (an app whose development was force-pushed, say) arrives
looking exactly like the old one.
An entry here is reported and does NOT fail. Anything not here still fails.
An entry that has STOPPED being refused also fails, so a dead entry cannot sit
here silently pre-authorising the next divergence in that app.

2026-08-28: the R80.4 entry was removed. Its stated review condition - "when R80.4's ruleset allows a merge commit, or its development is recreated from main" - was met: R80.4 was reconciled with a merge commit (R80.4#266), so the app is no longer refused. The gate itself demanded the removal, which is the entry's own design: a dead entry must not sit here pre-authorising the next divergence.
